description: Temporal context for data availability - helps LLM understand data date ranges

dataset_25m_table.description: Primary transaction dataset with DATE-type Posting_Date

Posting_Date.usage: Direct comparison and extraction (e.g., WHERE Posting_Date >= '2025-01-01', EXTRACT(MONTH FROM Posting_Date))

sales_order_cockpit_export.description: Sales order and delivery data with DATE-type Delivery_PGI_Date

Posting_Date.usage: Must use PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', Posting_Date) for date operations or direct string comparison (e.g., WHERE Posting_Date >= '2025-01-01')

relative_date_handling.last_quarter: Use Q2 2025 (2025-04-01 to 2025-06-30) as latest complete quarter
relative_date_handling.last_6_months: Use 2025-02-01 to 2025-07-29 for delivery data, 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-30 for posting data
relative_date_handling.year_to_date: Use 2025-01-01 to latest available date for 2025 YTD
relative_date_handling.current_quarter: Use Q2 2025 (2025-04-01 to 2025-06-30) as latest complete quarter
relative_date_handling.last_month: For delivery queries, use 2025-06-01 to 2025-06-30 (June 2025) as complete month

important: Data availability varies by table: delivery data through July 29, 2025; posting data through June 30, 2025
For sales_order_cockpit_export with Delivery_PGI_Date: data available through 2025-07-29
For dataset_25m_table with Posting_Date: data available through 2025-06-30
When queries ask for 'last month', use June 2025 (2025-06-01 to 2025-06-30) as the most recent COMPLETE month
For transaction_data table, Posting_Date is STRING format 'YYYY-MM-DD' - use PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', Posting_Date) or direct string comparison
For dataset_25m_table and sales_order_cockpit_export, date columns are DATE type - use direct date operations
Avoid CURRENT_DATE() in WHERE clauses - use explicit dates based on data availability
